player_context.note: Newer appearances carry more weight. Ice time has a 14-appearance half-life; production per minute has a 110-appearance half-life. The offseason does not age player history. Expected shots scale with the opponent’s shots allowed, and scoring with its goals allowed, relative to the league. A player who has consistently beaten (or missed) our earlier forecasts gets a shrunk adjustment toward that record. Observed averages below are unweighted. assessment.model_case: Projected 17.9 minutes yields a mean of about 2.0 and a median of 2, so a third shot is needed to lose. The weakness is that the role is unverified, and a power-play bump would add volume quickly.
assessment.price_case: At -146 on the main line, break-even is near -146 against a model fair price around -208. The low end of the sensitivity range still sits above break-even. The model-market gap is moderate rather than extreme.

qualitative_review.countercase: Shot counts have a long right tail, and a single extra shot flips the result. If Rangers forward absences elevate Lafrenière to a top line or PP1, his volume could exceed the model's 17.9-minute assumption. The model is experimental, with no established betting edge.
